content: Annotation guidelines can be applied to ensure that annotated corpus has less errors because the manual annotation is applied. Even though there are guidelines for annotating, the available output corpora are still inconsistent. For example, for the Vietnamese Treebank corpus of the VLSP project, Nguyen et al. listed out several Vietnamese word segmentation inconsistencies in the corpus based on POS information and n-gram sequences BIBREF14 .
